title: Reading Time
description: Two Fridays a month from 16.30-17.30 All kids aged 6 years & up are invited to join Julia or Claire twice a month on Fridays! We meet and read stories in English. Usually we do a craft, game or other fun activity afterwards. If you’d like to come please reserve a place by phone (0721) 7 27 52 email (bibliothek-amerika@kultur.karlsruhe.de)
